name: io.github.LumabyteCo/clarifyprompt
description: Context-aware AI prompt compiler for 58+ platforms — workspace signal gathering, intent resolution, target-model capability hints, local tracing, custom platforms

environmentVariables.description: LLM API endpoint URL (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic)
environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for the LLM provider (not needed for local Ollama)
environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Model name/ID to use for optimization
environmentVariables.name: LLM_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Canonical data directory for traces, persistent memory (SQLite), knowledge packs, and config (default: ~/.clarifyprompt, respects XDG_DATA_HOME). Supersedes CLARIFYPROMPT_DATA_DIR and CLARIFYPROMPT_CONFIG_DIR from 1.2.0+.
environmentVariables.name: CLARIFYPROMPT_HOME

environmentVariables.description: Legacy alias for CLARIFYPROMPT_HOME (still works; emits a one-line deprecation hint).
environmentVariables.name: CLARIFYPROMPT_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Trace mode: off | local | otel (default: local). Traces are strictly local JSONL; nothing is uploaded.
environmentVariables.name: CLARIFYPROMPT_TRACE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding endpoint URL for semantic memory + knowledge-pack retrieval (default: falls back to LLM_API_URL — Ollama users just work).
environmentVariables.name: EMBED_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Embedding API key (default: falls back to LLM_API_KEY; not needed for local Ollama).
environmentVariables.name: EMBED_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name (default: nomic-embed-text:v1.5 — pull it with `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`). Switch to text-embedding-3-small for OpenAI, voyage-3 for Voyage, embed-english-v3.0 for Cohere.
environmentVariables.name: EMBED_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Embedding dimension (default: 768 for nomic-embed-text). Set to match your embedding model's output: 1536 for text-embedding-3-small, 1024 for voyage-3, etc.
environmentVariables.name: EMBED_DIMENSION
